commit_message:
feat(scan): simplify camera scan button labels and fix width

Drop the rotation-degree suffix and keyboard-shortcut hints from the Rotate view, Rescan, and Recalibrate button labels for a cleaner control bar. Give the buttons a shared min-width with centered text so labels of different lengths don't cause the buttons to resize.

Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow

findings.issue: min-width: 150px added with no comment/rationale; magic number picked to fit longest label, breaks silently if label text changes later.

Button text dropped hotkey hints ('(R)', '(K)') and dynamic rotation degrees, but title attributes still say 'R or Space' / 'K' and aria-label still reports rotation degrees - visible label and accessible name now diverge.

historical.message:
refactor(scan): dedupe hotkey hints and equalize control sizes

Strip the (R)/(K) parentheticals from the Rescan and Recalibrate buttons
now that the always-on legend already lists those keys; hover tooltips
still name them. Drop the dynamic degree suffix from the Rotate label
(the is-active state and aria-label already convey rotation). Give the
shared camera-control spec a uniform min-width so the toolbar controls
render the same size.

Constraint: legend remains the single visible keybinding reference; tooltips keep the keys discoverable on hover.
Rejected: removing keys from the legend instead of the buttons (legend was the agreed always-on shortcut surface).
Directive: no duplicate keybindings, make the controls all the same size.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: no automated coverage of button labels or control widths (none pre-existed); tsc and biome pass.
